title: Exercise host-filtered status counts, search totals and independent session surfaces
outcome: Behavior tests catch host status/count/breakdown/search-total regressions and cross-surface selection leakage.
acceptance: Mixed-host/mixed-status tests select a host and a status, assert visible rows plus chip totals/working breakdown/search total on docked and standalone panels.
Selecting a host in one mounted surface leaves the other surface's host choice and rows unchanged.
